steps.title: Enter Your Pattern
steps.description: Type your regular expression pattern in the pattern input field. You can use standard regex syntax like ^, $, ., *, +, ?, [], {}, etc.

steps.title: Set Flags
steps.description: Select regex flags if needed: Global (g) for all matches, Case-insensitive (i), Multiline (m), etc.

steps.title: Enter Test String
steps.description: Type or paste the text you want to test your pattern against in the test string field.

steps.title: View Results
steps.description: See matches highlighted in real-time. Check the match list below to see all matches, groups, and positions.

steps.title: Read Explanation
steps.description: Use the explanation panel to understand what each part of your regex pattern does.

steps.title: Use Pattern Library
steps.description: Browse the pattern library for common patterns like email validation, URL extraction, phone numbers, etc.
